id./param/scenario/cs/b_110_cs_030.pack|cs_: "Lift your face, Frysabel. A ruler must never worry her people, whatever the time.
"Lord Rab! And {var:1} and the others! Oh, you're all alive!
"It's been a while. You look well yourself, Frysabel.
"Thank goodness. Even with the Tree fallen, darkness over the world, and Gold Fever spreading here... hope remained.
"...Hm, Frysabel. Did you say Gold Fever? What is happening in this land?
"Since a few weeks ago, a strange disease suddenly spread across Sniflheim.
"Anyone infected, human, animal, even plant, has their body turn to gold.
"With no known cause or cure, frightened people began calling it Gold Fever.
"Calling for help is impossible. A giant golden iceberg closed all land and sea routes. We are cut off.
"Krystalinda, the witch studying the disease, was suspected and locked in the castle dungeon.
"As her friend I tried to free her, but the people strongly opposed. Gold Fever has thrown this country into chaos.
"Such a thing... But rest easy, Frysabel. We'll investigate the mystery of Gold Fever.
"I'll tell the castle staff and townspeople to cooperate with you. ...Please, I'm counting on you.
